# Pinned Visual Truth development tool

This is the unchanged Visual Truth 1.3.0 package already used by TinyStudio's
Vite development integration. Its MIT license permits redistribution; the
original license is retained here, inside the package, and in the application
license assets. The package terms state that generated source may be reviewed,
committed and deployed, while the editor operates only in development.

The local archive is a reproducible build input. No developer home directory or
external Codex installation is needed by npm or the Docker frontend stage.
The npm lockfile retains the package's original integrity value.
